context: Post-hoc proxy analysis; no independently verified blink labels. Private events, masks and waveform figures are withheld.

metrics_definitions.nmse: MSE/target population variance, computed separately per electrode then averaged
metrics_definitions.pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean squared error across all retained samples and four targets))
metrics_definitions.statistical_inference: NONE; correlated within-recording samples, windows, channels

limitations: no outcome-guided thresholds or manual event selection
no automatic rejection of original samples
Proxy labels are not confirmed blinks. False positives and missed events are possible.
Untouched contexts are not guaranteed artifact-free; zero-phase filters can spread transients beyond the fixed mask.
Original all-data endpoint remains unchanged. Conditional subsets are new descriptive analyses.
No actual blink count, neural restoration, denoising or population validity is established.
